Chapter 2 of Element of Darkness is here!

Elena, the Queen of Darkness, has been born… but Mia has a history with her. Can she save Elena, or is it already too late? You'll have to read to find out.

This chapter took longer than expected, so I've decided to release it in monthly progress updates rather than making you wait 5 to 6 months for the full thing and then another half a year for Chapter 3. My personal work schedule is unpredictable, so some months I might produce 100 pages, others maybe just 10. This way you always have something to look forward to.

I'm also launching my Patreon! If you'd like to support me, you'll get 1 month early access and higher tiers can vote on mini comic topics and access textless renders of Element of Darkness at www.patreon.com/IndigoWingsComic

The honest reason I need support right now: I jumped into Daz not realizing it requires an NVIDIA GPU. I have AMD, which makes everything significantly slower. A new GPU would make a real difference in what I can create and how fast.
Thank you so much for reading.

Feel free to comment on what you liked, what didn't land, suggestions, anything. It all helps.
See you!
